skill.name: power-bi-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Power BI Desktop or needs to prepare data, inspect an exported Performance Analyzer file, plan or validate report/model/project changes, diagnose refresh, or work with published Power BI state. Routes each workflow by retained state among sandbox files, capabilities exposed in the current Manus session, My Browser, and conditional Windows Desktop guidance.
skill.userDescription: Prepare data, diagnose performance, and plan Power BI reports and models.
exampleQuestions: Analyze this Power BI Performance Analyzer export.
Plan a Power BI data model for a sales dashboard.
Help me diagnose a Power BI refresh problem.
